title: Material descriptor
description: Authoring source for a RES_MATERIAL asset, cooked by tools/cook_assets.py. Lives under assets/materials/, mirroring assets/textures/ path-for-path so a texture picked in TrenchBroom's material browser resolves to the material of the same relative path. See docs/formats/MATERIAL_FORMAT.md.

shaderType.description: Which fixed slot mapping this material's parameters use. A future shader type (e.g. 'water') adds its own field set here without touching pbr_standard's.

albedo.description: Source image, relative to this file. Optional -- a flat-colour material needs none.

normal.description: Tangent-space normal map source image, relative to this file. Optional.

orm.description: Pre-packed occlusion(R)/roughness(G)/metallic(B) source image, relative to this file. Mutually exclusive with occlusion/roughness/metallic.

occlusion.description: Separate ambient-occlusion source image (the common case art ships in). Packed with roughness/metallic into one ORM texture at cook time.

roughness.description: Separate roughness source image. Packed with occlusion/metallic into one ORM texture at cook time.

metallic.description: Separate metallic source image. Packed with occlusion/roughness into one ORM texture at cook time.

baseColorFactor.description: RGBA, multiplied with the albedo map (or used alone when there is none).
